text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Testing, testing.
Hi! It's Machan. I'm at
summer camp once again.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've been feeling pretty good recently,
for lots of
reasons. Firstly, I'm physically
very healthy.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...It's starting to feel like the troubles I
had in
spring weren't even real.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What's more, our blog traffic numbers
that my
trainer was worried about have
also recovered.
The site's doing very
well.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And now, I have my rematch waiting for
me in
September. I'm going to do my
best.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Will I be able to give it my best shot? I
think I
will.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. When did you get here?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...So, it looks like today's guest is my
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This year's summer camp has begun.
